term: one-world witnessing of a union loop
definition: NoSingleWorldCycle denies, at every world w and necessary b, a nonempty TransGen loop whose every edge both belongs to the union and is witnessed by PresentEsseSupport at that same w. It excludes a whole path being witnessed there; it does not assert unique worlds for its edges or exclude edges shared by worlds.
note: Source-free finite graph investigation #604. No metaphysical actuality, divine identity, uniqueness, or root discharge is asserted.
